name: Shawn Pruitt

five_sec.trust_why: Says no card. That's a start
five_sec.delivers_food_why: App store buttons. It's an app

full_page.what_stopped_me: I don't have recipes to save. I have frozen pizza. Then it's $5.95 a month

PTE.quote: 'Save recipes while you scroll.' I scroll ESPN. I ain't got recipes to save.

five_sec.what_is_it: Some dinner outfit with a video
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Could be a box. Can't tell from the top

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Try Free for 14 Days' and no price anywhere. Then a pop-up with 'No commitment. Cancel anytime.' Heard that before

EM.quote: 'Try Free for 14 Days.' Then what? No price anywhere. Heard 'cancel anytime' from the last outfit too.

five_sec.what_is_it: Plans dinner, texts the family to pick, puts the list in Walmart
five_sec.trust_why: Says flat out they don't deliver food. Good

full_page.what_stopped_me: Not much. $0, no card, Walmart cart. Kids vote by text so I'm not the bad guy. But the voting is the Family part, $4.99 after two weeks. And it texts every kid 8 ideas; I don't want five kids getting spam. Doesn't say how it handles 4 people Monday and 7 Thursday
full_page.whats_missing: How often it texts the kids and how to stop it; a head count that changes by night

DD.quote: 'We don't deliver food.' Good. Free, no card, Walmart, and the kids vote by text so they can't blame me. I'll give it a week.

five_sec.trust_why: Been there. Now they want me to open a box for a prize

full_page.what_stopped_me: Skipped a week, got charged anyway. Fine print still says 'auto-renewing'

HF.quote: 'Pause or cancel anytime.' Skipped a week, got charged anyway. Not opening their little box.

five_sec.who_for: Folks who want a robot for dinner
five_sec.trust_why: Big button is a letter from the CEO. Just tell me what it costs

full_page.what_stopped_me: $25 a month and they count your messages. Free is 50 a month
full_page.whats_missing: A price that makes sense for seven people

OL.quote: Twenty-five bucks a month and they count your texts. With seven people? That's gone by Tuesday.

dd_offer.why: 'Free forever' and 'Family free 14 days' on the same page. Had to read twice to see which part stays free
dd_offer.expect_day_15: Kids' texting quits, I'm back on the free one. They don't have my card, so they can't pull a HelloFresh on me.

head_to_head.reason: Free with no card, Walmart, no box, and the kids can vote

EM.reason: DinnerDrop shows the price; eMeals hides it

PTE.reason: It picks the dinners for me

HF.reason: Not a box, can't charge me

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page Family section: say exactly how many texts a week the kids get and that they can reply STOP, and show it can plan for 4 on some nights and 7 on others.
